name: dead-agent-skills
description: Personal skills, flows and integrations for Claude Code and Codex.

scripts.test: node scripts/check-repo.mjs && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include="tools/installer/**" --test-coverage-exclude="tools/installer/**/*.test.ts" --test-coverage-lines=84 "tools/installer/**/*.test.ts" && npm test --workspace=@dead-claude-skills/harness-compiler && node --test "scripts/*.test.mjs" "plugins/flows/skills/build-feature/tests/*.test.mjs" "plugins/flows/skills/diagrams/tests/*.test.mjs" "plugins/default/hooks/*.test.mjs" "plugins/opt-in/headroom-trim/hooks/*.test.mjs" && npm test --workspace=@dead-claude-skills/upstream-sync
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace=@dead-claude-skills/harness-compiler && npm run typecheck --workspace=@dead-claude-skills/upstream-sync
scripts.scan-skills: pipx run --spec cisco-ai-skill-scanner==2.3.2 skill-scanner scan-all plugins --recursive --policy .github/skill-scanner.yaml --fail-on-severity high && pipx run --spec cisco-ai-skill-scanner==2.3.2 skill-scanner scan-all .claude-plugin/flows/skills --recursive --policy .github/skill-scanner.yaml --fail-on-severity high
